verdict.rationale: Codex supports starting cloud tasks from web/GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack and continuing from the CLI or web, plus 'codex resume' to reopen chats and cross-client MCP config shared across ChatGPT desktop, CLI, and IDE extension, enabling cross-device continuity. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of seamless cross-device handoff (community evidence focuses on model quality/performance, not multi-device continuity workflows), and no explicit documentation of syncing in-progress local CLI sessions to another physical device.
